name: My Sassy Princess
summary:
A re-imagination of classic tales in the modern society.

Meet the new "Cinderella", who doesn't wait for the Fairy Godmother to make her wishes come true. 

Snow White's beauty was once her danger. But for the Snow White of the new era, "Ugliness" is more threatening.

Meet the new Aurora: hot, free-spirited and daring. She journeys with confidence, knowing that—no matter what— her prince on a white horse will always come to save her if she falls.

name: Stolen Identity
summary: Nongnuch accepts a surrogacy offer for Namphet, a middle-aged woman yearning for motherhood, to support her husband Somdech's treatment. When Namphet's situation changes, Ploy, the baby girl, ends up living with Nongnuch in a slum, growing up without knowing her true biological relationship. Ploy takes on various roles to provide for her family, with Klatawan's support. Namphet's relentless search for her daughter ends with Ploy, and she secretly helps her. Nongnuch becomes aware of Namphet's affluence and schemes to use Ploy for her benefit.

name: A Wildflower in the City
summary: A story of an uptown girl who must journey to Bangkok to search for work and there, confronts difficulties from selfish people. How is she going to navigate her life around this new environment?

name: The Heart of Justice
summary: Dala adopted her sister's children while the father was wrongly imprisoned for murder. She strives to find her place in the recycling business with the help of valuable friends.

name: Princess Lover!
summary:
After his parents are killed in an accident, Teppei Kobayashi is adopted by his grandfather, Isshin Arima. After taking his grandfather's name, Teppei is made the heir to the Arima Financial Combine, one of the leading forces in the Japanese industry. As befits the heir to an industrial empire, he is enrolled in one of Japan's most prestigious international schools.

There, Teppei finds himself surrounded by women of noble bearing and status. He quickly falls for Sylvia van Hossen, a European princess and fencing master. But Sylvia is aloof and difficult to read, and his maid, Yuu Fujikura, seems to have her own agenda. Will Teppei become the Princess Lover, or is his romance with Sylvia destined for failure?

Unlike TV anime with the same title, this two-part OVA sub-series feature adult content.

name: The Necromancer! I Am A Disaster
summary: The game has crossed into reality, and the old rules no longer apply. Humanity enters an age where anyone can awaken a class, but the opportunity draws unwanted attention: demons from the abyss and the dragonkin both want this new world, and neither is willing to share it. Lin Moyu wakes up in this world with the one class no one else has: Necromancer. His talent is unmatched, his ability system unlike anything else in play, and he grows stronger with every fight, building an army out of the dead until he no longer needs anyone else at his side. As the Shenxia Empire's last line of defense against the abyssal invasion, he becomes the one man capable of breaking the deadlock between humans, demons, and dragons, and the one who ends up standing above all three.

name: Evlilik Güzeldir
summary: The series tells the story of Mesut Bağımtıbar, a marriage registrar who dreams of marrying off his five daughters. However, each of his daughters has a completely different personality. The most striking character among the daughters is the eldest, Zeynep.

name: Barking!
summary: This live-action children's comedy follows a teenage girl adjusting to a fresh start in a quiet Devon town after her family relocates. To help smooth the transition, her new stepfather gifts her a pet dog. The twist: the dog secretly possesses the ability to talk, and she is the only person who knows! Mischievous, loud-mouthed, and wildly opinionated, the canine companion constantly drags his owner into ridiculous everyday scrapes, but despite the inevitable chaos, the two form an unbreakable bond as best friends.

name: Dugout Dads
summary:
Follows an idealistic dad who volunteers to coach his kids' Little League team and discovers that the most unruly players aren't the ten-year-olds but the other coaches, parents, and sometimes himself.

For the first time in 33 years, the original cast of The Sandlot reunites on screen in Dugout Dads, a heartfelt comedy about a first-time Little League coach who quickly discovers that while the kids are just there to have fun, the adults are playing for keeps.

name: Burning Nights In Beijing And Hongkong
summary: After giving up on a seven-year unrequited crush on her childhood friend, a young woman enters a flash marriage of convenience through a family alliance, only to discover that her notorious "playboy" husband is actually a fiercely devoted protector determined to make her fall hopelessly in love with him.

name: Οι Μικρομεσαίοι
summary:
Η Μάρθα Φασιανού και ο Παύλος Πετρίδης είναι συνάδελφοι σε ένα γραφείο εισαγωγών και εξαγωγών, όπου καθημερινά έρχονται αντιμέτωποι με τα μικρά και μεγάλα προβλήματα της ελληνικής πραγματικότητας.

Η Μάρθα, ύστερα από δύο αποτυχημένους γάμους, έχει αποφασίσει να μην ξαναπαντρευτεί, ενώ ο Παύλος είναι παντρεμένος με την Ελένη και προσπαθεί παράλληλα να διαχειριστεί το πολύχρωμο οικογενειακό του περιβάλλον: τη χωρισμένη αδελφή του Μπέτυ, την καταπιεστική μητέρα του Αφροδίτη και την πεθερά του Ζωρζέτ, η οποία έχει γνωρίσει τον Ανδρέα Χασιώτη και σκέφτεται να ξαναπαντρευτεί.

Μέσα από τις επαγγελματικές, οικογενειακές και προσωπικές περιπέτειες των ηρώων, δημιουργούνται συνεχώς κωμικές καταστάσεις και παρεξηγήσεις που σατιρίζουν την καθημερινότητα και τη νοοτροπία των μικρομεσαίων Νεοελλήνων της εποχής.

name: The Moon Over The Sea Is The Moon In The Sky
summary:
Song Jingnan spends ten years devoted to an intense and unrequited love for Fu Siyuan. For years, she gives him her companionship and affection, hoping that one day he will finally see her feelings. When Jiang Yuning returns to China, Fu Siyuan's heart begins to waver. Unable to let go of his childhood sweetheart while still clinging to the comfort of Song Jingnan's years of devotion, he becomes caught between the two women. His hesitation and emotional distance gradually fill their relationship with suspicion and disappointment.

Eventually, Song Jingnan becomes exhausted from waiting. She finally realizes that continuing to chase someone who cannot give her the love she deserves means losing herself in the process. Choosing to step away, she withdraws from Fu Siyuan and begins focusing on her own life and happiness. Only after losing Song Jingnan does Fu Siyuan realize how much she meant to him. He finally understands that the childhood love he had held onto for so long was never something he could truly have, while the person who had always been by his side was the one he had taken for granted.

Meanwhile, Gu Yanting, who has quietly loved Song Jingnan for many years, begins to enter her life. Without forcing her or demanding anything in return, he patiently stays by her side, giving her the care and affection she once spent years longing for. With the past behind her and a new love waiting ahead, Song Jingnan must decide what she truly wants. After ten years of unrequited love, will she return to the man she once devoted everything to, or will she finally choose herself—and the person who has loved her all along?

name: Europe's Wild Kingdoms
summary:
Across Europe, world-famous heritage sites such as Mont-Saint-Michel, Bran Castle, the Alhambra and Duart Castle draw visitors for their history and beauty. Yet beneath their grand façades lies a lesser-known story. Shaped by centuries of human activity, these sites and their surrounding landscapes are now home to a surprising range of wildlife, from harbour seals and red deer to black storks and elusive amphibians. 

This two-part series explores how Europe's most celebrated landmarks and the animals that live among them have become closely intertwined, using specialist wildlife filming to reveal nature thriving in historic places.

name: Thousand Mountains Evening Snow
summary: Tong Xue is deeply entangled in complex layers of conflict. For three years, she has been by the side of the aloof and reserved Mo Shaoqian, their relationship a tumultuous mix of love and hate, filled with unspoken endurance. An unexpected reunion with an old acquaintance brings a cascade of misunderstandings that continually pull the two apart. She holds fast to her true self, finding her own path forward through her talent, while he learns to let go of his obsessions and makes peace with his past.

name: Floricienta
summary:
Surely, had Cinderella been a young woman in the year 2000, her path to happiness would undoubtedly have been different; instead of scrubbing floors, she would be looking for work just to get by, and she wouldn't ask her fairy godmother for a dress or a carriage, but rather for time and the chance to do what she loves in life.

Furthermore, she wouldn't sit around waiting for Prince Charming to rescue her; instead, she would go out and find him herself—showing us who would actually be rescuing whom—because times have definitely changed.

name: True Colours
summary: About a pair of childhood lovers who get together after experiencing a breakup from their previous relationships

name: Trafics
summary: Trafics follows an elite customs investigation unit as they fight to dismantle dangerous smuggling networks while balancing high-pressure professional duties and volatile personal secrets.

name: Tampa: The Turning Point
summary:
When Afghan refugee Abbas Nazari boards a dilapidated Indonesian fishing vessel with over 400 others in 2001, he has no idea he's about to be at the centre of one of the most dramatic chapters in Australian history.

Tampa: The Turning Point re-examines the August 2001 MV Tampa crisis, marking 25 years since the eight-day maritime standoff that reshaped Australian border protection and global immigration policies.

name: ТВ-3 ведёт расследование
summary: For many years, the information that we will make public for the first time was stored in archives under the "secret" classification and was known only to a very narrow circle of scientists and experts. The time has come to conduct an objective, impartial investigation and reveal the truth…

name: Diplomatic Immunity
summary: Diplomatic Immunity centers on a young American doctor who is suddenly assigned to the medical office at the U.S. Embassy in Rome. He finds himself encountering challenging medical cases that require him to navigate diplomacy, government personalities and geopolitical situations - all while managing the romantic entanglements set against the thrill of a new life in a new country.

name: Познер
summary: Pozner is an interview program. Vladimir Pozner asks questions to politicians, public figures, representatives of culture, art, science, and sports. The conversation may be either tied to the current events of the week or not directly related to them.

name: Gutierrez is mai neim
summary: Following the assassination of the Russian ambassador, the case falls to Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez, a police officer ill-prepared for such a task. When the CIA, led by Mike Robinson, takes control, Gutierrez decides to play by his own rules. With a team as loyal as it is incompetent and methods of dubious legality, he will unleash chaos to demonstrate who's boss in his territory and solve the case before the Americans.

name: Paolo
summary: Paolo's ordinary working-class existence is upended when he encounters the ambitious, and magnetic local politician Téophane, an old school mate. What begins as admiration and a desire to help Téophane's campaign, soon spirals into an all-consuming obsession, leading to a deadly ride in this intense psychological Ripley-style thriller.

name: Kilder til begeistring
summary: Everyday life is full of things to be happy about, you just have to notice them. Every Monday for 52 weeks, we present a new source of excitement.

previousepisode.name: Å gå kveldstur under en landskamp

name: Wei Nu San Nian Hou, Zheng Ge Hou Fu Gui Zhe Qiu Wo Yuan Liang
Hun Li Xian Chang，Wo Cheng Le Qian Nan You Hou Ma
From Cold Palace to the Throne
summary: Psychology PhD Lin Qingwan transmigrates into the body of a disgraced concubine banished to the Cold Palace after being falsely accused of poisoning the emperor's heir. With her entire family executed, she is trapped in a deadly predicament. Using psychological analysis to see through people's motives, forensic toxicology to unravel conspiracies, emergency medicine to save herself and others, and economic expertise to reform the imperial government, she begins by winning over the eunuchs of the Cold Palace. Leveraging the emperor's attention, she rises step by step until she is made Imperial Noble Consort. She exposes the Duke of State-Defending's conspiracy to frame her family, clears their name, and avenges their deaths. When the emperor falls gravely ill, she confesses her identity as a transmigrator. Ultimately, she earns his trust, takes over the imperial court, and ascends the throne, becoming Dasheng's first female emperor. She introduces the imperial civil service examinations for women, revises inheritance laws, opens a new Silk Road, and establishes the Tiangong Institute. Breaking the shackles of feudal society, she ushers in an era of prosperity and splendor. This is the legendary story of a modern, educated woman who uses her knowledge and abilities to defy fate and change her destiny. Watch as she fights her way out of a deadly predicament and rises to become an emperor remembered throughout the ages.

name: I Don't Wanna Go to Work Today
summary: Zhou Cancan, a clearheaded and confident manager focused on making money, and Li Jinshu, a secretly wealthy heir who is aloof on the outside but innocent at heart, find themselves in a double identity mix-up as workplace rivals and online lovers. As they spend time together amid the everyday bustle of Chengdu, their bickering and push and pull gradually turn into mutual love.

name: Big Brother: The Group Chat
summary:
As Big Brother returns this autumn on ITV2 and ITVX for its biggest series yet, Big Brother: The Group Chat will give fans even more action, bringing them closer to the personalities, dynamics and relationships at the heart of the series. With exclusive interviews with evicted Housemates, celebrity fans and special guests, viewers can expect strong opinions, plenty of personality and the inside scoop from those who know the house best.

From the biggest moments to the hot topics sparking conversation, Kate and GK will be on hand to dissect the drama, celebrate the stand-out scenes and weigh in on the decisions and surprises shaping the game. Whether it's an unexpected shake-up, an unlikely alliance or a moment that has everyone talking, Big Brother: The Group Chat will be the place to continue the conversation after Big Brother each night.

name: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena
summary: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena builds upon Rice University's Center for the Impossible, one of the world's largest collections of paranormal research, by inviting everyday individuals, many of whom have never spoken publicly before, to reveal their new and personal encounters with unexplained phenomena.

name: Still Flipping Out
summary:
The new series follows former "Flipping Out" star Jeff Lewis as he navigates the demands of his hit SiriusXM show on Radio Andy, an eponymous design empire, and everything in-between.   

The king of controlled chaos with a charged personality, Jeff is as outspoken as ever, but this time the mic is always on. As he works to balance his professional and personal lives, his trademark spontaneity collides with the people who work with him, for him and still somehow survive him.

name: Youth
summary: Youth follows a 50-year-old divorcee's search for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.

name: Seni Tanıyorum
summary: After giving birth, Funda wants to return to painting, the career she had paused, and finally finds the nanny she has been looking for. Nanny Nazlı's mystery and unsettling nature will change Funda and her husband İlker's lives forever.

name: Big Daddy's House
summary: Aaron McCargo Jr., winner of season four of "The Next Food Network Star," collects his grand prize in the form of this series, which spotlights McCargo's passion for big, bold flavors and family-friendly food. Many of his recipes are inspired by his own family.

name: Big Ideas for a Small Planet
summary: Forward-thinking designers, entrepreneurs, and everyday citizens are profiled as they develop practical, eco-friendly alternatives to traditional practices across everyday areas like fashion, architecture, food, and transportation. By highlighting cutting-edge green technologies and sustainable lifestyle choices, an optimistic, solutions-oriented look is provided into how human ingenuity and everyday innovations can help combat the global environmental crisis to build a healthier, greener world.

name: Big Eddie
summary: A reformed mobster and former gambler attempts to go straight by managing a New York sports arena. To secure legal custody of his young orphaned granddaughter, he marries his ex-stripper girlfriend, creating a chaotic household. The series follows his constant struggle to navigate a legitimate business and respectable domestic life while fending off eccentric former underworld cronies who keep dragging him back into his past.

name: The Joy of Pets
summary: Join Gaby Roslin and vet Dr Bolu Eso for a celebration of Britain's pets in this heartwarming series packed with extraordinary animals, incredible stories and plenty of surprises!

name: Одержимость
summary: When Gleb's wife Liza vanishes on New Year's Eve and is accused of murder in a distant town, he journeys to Ovrazhe to uncover her hidden secrets while fighting to prove her innocence.

name: Desired Kisses
summary: Sang Chuzhi's seven-year boyfriend sends her to his uncle Shang Yuzhou's bed in order to secure an investment. Unexpectedly, the cold Mr. Shang does not drive her out and even marries her immediately. Even more shocking is that all this is actually premeditated by Shang. Adapted from the Fanqie Novel "Kissed Red and Warm by the Flirty and Seductive Mr. Shang After Marriage" by Wang Fan Xing.

name: I Took A Vacation, And Incidentally Became The Boss's Wife
The Unheard
summary: The Unheard tells the story of two sisters who go on the run after an act of vengeance goes wrong. As they are desperately pursued, questions remain: What pushed them to this reckless act? And was it ever their intention to get away with it?

name: Fatal First Dates
summary: In an age of dating apps and instant connection, the search for love can carry unseen risks. Fatal First Dates tells the true stories of people who set out in search of romance and instead found themselves face to face with tragedy. Carefully reported and human-centred, each episode follows a standalone case, tracing events from the first swipe or chance meeting through a descent into manipulation, obsession and betrayal. Using dramatic reconstruction, police recordings and testimony from families, investigators and survivors, the series examines how seemingly ordinary encounters took a devastating turn.

name: After Mr. Xie Lost His Memory, He Demands a Proper Status
David Pollack Primetime
summary: David Pollack Primetime delivers a fact-driven breakdown of the day's major political stories, slowing down complex news to analyze the facts and explain what they mean for the American people through rigorous debate and expert discussion.

name: The Program: Texas Tech
summary: The Program: Texas Tech gives unprecedented access into the Texas Tech University Red Raiders College Football Program - including exclusive interviews with head coach Joey McGuire, former quarterback Brendan Sorsby, Chairman of the Texas Tech University System Board of Regents Cody Campbell, and more - through one of the most consequential off-seasons in the history of the sport.

name: Did someone happen to mention me?
Meet the Owens
summary: Forget everything you think you know about Michael Owen. This is an action-packed and unexpectedly hilarious year in the life of the footballer-turned-Horse-Racing-Stable-owner & his famous family. Michael juggles a business on the edge with a chaotic home life, while daughter Gemma swaps social media for the saddle to become a jockey. Funny, warm… and far from boring.

name: Mal de Amores
summary: Daniel Cuenca lives for revolution. Dr. Antonio Zavalza heals its wounds. Fiery Emilia must choose whom she loves more as Mexico transforms around her.

name: Woven Whale
summary: In her previous life; Jiang Mingzhi broke off relations with her loving mother and stepfather all for her love with Pei Jinyang. However; less than a year into their marriage; Pei Jinyang's passion faded; and he cheated on her; betraying their relationship. After witnessing Pei Jinyang's infidelity; Jiang Mingzhi proposed a divorce; left him; but died in a car accident—only to be unexpectedly reborn to the time before she met Pei Jinyang. In this new life; Jiang Mingzhi is determined not to repeat her past mistakes. She decides to stay away from Pei Jinyang and cherish the family bond with her mother and stepfather.

name: Lando
summary: A closer look at F1 World Champion Lando Norris as he defends his title while balancing the pressures of racing with family, friendships, and life beyond the track. From his early karting days in Bristol to his rise to the top of Formula 1, explore his passion for racing, determination to win, and the person behind the champion.

name: Not A Sound
summary: After losing her hearing in a devastating hit-and-run, disgraced ER nurse Amelia Winn and her fiercely loyal service dog discover the murdered body of a former colleague — pulling Amelia into a deadly mystery that could finally reveal the truth about the accident that changed her life.

name: Jack Reed
summary: The Jack Reed series was a collection of six NBC made-for-TV crime drama movies broadcast between 1992 and 1996. Starring Brian Dennehy as the real-life Cook County Homicide Investigator, the overarching premise for the franchise focuses on a dedicated, old-school Chicago police sergeant who battles both ruthless criminals and deep-seated internal department bureaucracy to solve high-profile mu

name: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini
summary: Host Gabe Bertaccini cooks some of his favorite Italian dishes to share with friends and family.

name: The Bill Dana Show
summary: The Bill Dana Show follows the sweet, naive, and well-meaning Latin American immigrant José Jiménez as he navigates daily life and misadventures working as a bellhop at a swanky, upscale hotel in New York City

name: Everyone in My Family Has Killed Someone
summary: Ern Cunningham, a mystery-writing expert, reluctantly attends a family reunion to welcome his brother Michael home from prison — the same brother Ern helped convict. When a frozen body appears and a snowstorm traps everyone inside, the deaths begin to mount. Everyone in his family has already killed someone – either by accident or otherwise.

name: Selling Sex
summary: Nelly is 25, smart, ambitious, and broke. Unhappy with her low-paying internship, run-of-the-mill part-time job, and forgettable Tinder dates, she's looking for something more. When a former coworker invites her to join her escort agency, it opens the door to a new life for her.

name: Meztelen igazság
summary: The Naked Truth is a five-part documentary series that tells the stories of people who were themselves part of this world. With the help of former adult film stars, producers, directors, family members, lawyers, and experts, the series sheds light on an industry that, for decades, made Hungary one of the hubs of the international adult film sector. In addition, the series also addresses the international scandals surrounding foreign adult film producers working in Hungary.

name: Dive into You
summary: Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

name: Joko & Klaas machen Urlaub
summary: The two entertainers, Joko Winterscheidt and Klaas Heufer-Umlauf, are demanding more holiday from their employer, ProSieben, whilst their employer, in turn, is demanding that they produce a new joint programme. The way out of this dilemma? They'll be granted their holiday if they go on a road trip together and let themselves be filmed whilst doing so. The special twist: unlike in their numerous previous programmes, the whole thing is to take place without challenges, without games and without winners or losers. Joko & Klaas are going on holiday in Iceland.

previousepisode.name: Tauchen zwischen zwei Kontinenten und Gänsehaut-Geschichten über Elfen

name: NFL Play Action
summary: NFL Play Action brings a fresh, dynamic energy to game week, pairing Brandt's football pedigree with Love's fluency of sports, fashion, and entertainment. Together, they'll anchor the can't-miss weekly cultural recap of NFL football this fall, spotlighting the biggest storylines, stars, and moments both on and off the field.

name: The Phoenix's Other Self
summary: A princess and an assassin uncover a shocking sisterhood, overcome betrayal, and join forces before finding freedom together.

name: АВТОРСКАЯ КОМНАТА
summary: An improvisational show where the audience takes part in writing jokes together with Sergei Orlov.

name: Looney Tunes Gokko
summary: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Lola Bunny, Tweety... so many friends are all here! This Gokko (or "pretend play") series has all your favorite Looney Tunes characters like you've never seen them before!

name: Arrivals: A New Manifest Mystery
summary: In Arrivals: A New Manifest Mystery, when a mysterious plane crash-lands in Denver, the passengers emerge with no memory of who they are, where they came from, or why they're here. A young social worker and a novice Homeland Security agent team up with the new arrivals in an attempt to stop a humanity-ending catastrophe, discovering along the way that they are all part of the very puzzle they're trying to solve.

name: Shaidai
summary: Shaidai is a celebration of love, a story that dares to ask what happens when the most beautiful feeling in the world turns into its greatest test. Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson. Miral is a self made girl who wants to do everything on her own. Vivid, sharp tongued, and fiercely certain of her own path, she moves through life with a conviction that refuses to be dimmed. Fate, indifferent to logic and timing, brings their names together. But love, it seems, has made enemies before they even knew it existed. From the shadows, forces driven by old grievances and hidden motives begin to close in, testing not just their bond but everything they believe in. What storms lie ahead in Ali and Miral's love? Can two people who found each other against all odds hold on when the odds turn against them? And when love is pushed to its breaking point, who will be left standing?

name: Zanjeerain
summary: Love, greed, loyalty, and traditions clash in a picturesque mountain village. Rabiya, a resilient roadside bakery owner, gradually becomes entangled in a web of conspiracy in the local clan.

name: Crime Scene Raw
summary: Crime Scene Raw focuses on a different high-profile case each episode, utilizing police bodycam footage and forensic evidence.

name: Fred's Ultimate Hotels
summary: From lavish lobbies to sublime service, Fred Sirieix checks into the world's most spectacular hotels to discover the people, precision and passion that create a truly unforgettable hotel stay.

name: Sevdam Karadeniz
summary:
"Sevdam Karadeniz" tells the story of a long-standing feud between two influential families from the Black Sea region, which began with the unfinished love story of Hafize Alazlı and Durali Yeniceli. Years later, this feud forces their grandchildren, Kuzey and Zeyşan, into an arranged marriage.

Caught between family secrets, forbidden love, and vows of revenge, the two young people must make a choice that could change the fate of both families forever.

The series is set in Trabzon and is produced by Mia Yapım. It is directed by Aytaç Çiçek, with the screenplay written by Özge Korkmaz, Yeşim Gülay, and Zeynep Şirin.

name: Ao to Midori
summary: Ao gives affection freely, while Midori guards his own heart. Drawn together in high school but constrained by social expectations, they remain trapped in a mutual, unrequited love for eight years. Step by delicate step, they must decide if their deep bond is worth the risk of falling.

name: The Brothers
summary: Two polar-opposite brothers—one shy and retiring, the other excitable and domineering—navigate comedic misadventures and sibling rivalry while co-running a photography studio in San Francisco.

name: Beyond Wukong
summary: Born from a sacred stone, Sun Xiaosheng sets out west to uncover a deadly mystery and forge his own legend.

name: Camera Café
summary: Several employers of a Spanish company are always filmed by a camera that it is on a café machine, and it shows their problems and funny moments of their lives.

name: Surveillant!
summary: Corinne Maillard is the director of the Chénoise detention center. Day to day, she tends to be overprotective of the inmates and her rather clumsy team of guards, like a smothering mother. But everything changes when her son, with whom she has lost contact, is incarcerated in her facility. She tries to reconnect with him while continuing to fulfill her responsibilities.

name: Magical Explorer
summary:
The legendary bishoujo game "Magical★Explorer"

I was reincarnated not as the protagonist surrounded by heroines thanks to my cheat abilities, but as Takine Kousuke, the unfortunate friend character who just puts on a forced smile beside them ...!

In the original game, he's inconspicuous, unrewarded, and remains a supporting character until the very end. But I have the knowledge from my past life, having played this game to its fullest extent! Furthermore, this friend character has a hidden ability: "the world's highest magical power," potentially surpassing even the protagonist...?

In order to lead the heroines he has longed for and met in this world to happy endings, his friend Kousuke fights his way through this world!

name: Candy Caries
summary: Ame is a child who loves sweets. Living inside her mouth is a cavity named Caries! Caries calls Ame "Mom," turns teeth into furniture, and even hijacks her body. Ame is always being pushed around by this free-spirited cavity. "I'm not your Mom!" Ame cries. "Yes you are! You gave me a room and feed me sweets," retorts Caries. Enjoy this slapstick comedy about a slightly strange parent-child pair!

name: The Lenticulars
summary: Here's my classmates Uta Aihara, Moripura-kun, and friends, who shared joys and sorrows with me during my trainee days, so please do check it out!! A natural, heart-fluttering youth story... but there are intriguing elements everywhere!

name: Aşk ve Taht
summary: Set to create a brand-new and magnificent narrative universe through its set design, storyline, and rich cast of characters, the production will bring to the screen a grand love story that has never before been told in history.

name: Earle Meets World
summary: Candid, chaotic and still getting started, influencer Alix Earle navigates breakups, best friends and a unique blended family in this reality series.

name: On Campus: Game of the Week
summary: Every week at a different school, go inside campus life with real college students from the lead-up to the aftermath of college football's biggest games.

name: Charlie & Co.
summary: Follows the Richmond family, headed by dad Charlie, a blue-collar worker, and his wife Diana.

name: Teeny Mutant Ninja Turtles
summary: Everyone's favorite ninja turtles, Leo, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey, are back! Set in their childhood years, this original series explores the early days of the iconic ninja turtles on their first adventures as ninjas-in-training. They'll even be joined by their friend April O'Neil, and encounter foes like Bebop, Rocksteady, and Karai.

name: Wolven: een spel van list en bedrog
summary: Thirteen specialists play a psychological game in a remote village, centered on observation, intuition, and deception. Each player is assigned a role: ten of them become Citizen and three a Wolf. But no one knows the roles. Every glance, remark, and choice is a potential clue. As the first suspicions arise, everyone tries to discover who is telling the truth and who is playing a double game. As night falls, it becomes clear that the game has begun.

name: Семейный очаг
summary: The series is about the life of three generations of a modern Russian family. The events unfold against the background of the relationship of journalist Anastasia Davydova, who hosts the radio talk show "Family hearth", her husband-playwright Andrey, their daughter-a high school student Yulia and an elderly father, a former officer Pavel Ivanovich.

name: Dziewczyna i chłopak
summary: Adventures of two tweens - Tosia and Tomek.

name: Celebrity Cooking Showdown
summary: Hosted by Alan Thicke, Celebrity Cooking Showdown is a 2006 reality television mini-series where pop culture stars team up with world-class chefs for an adrenaline-fueled culinary boot camp and real-time cooking competition.

name: Celebrity Exposé
summary: Celebrity Exposé is a weekly news television series that delivers in-depth profiles, behind-the-headlines looks, and investigative stories on major celebrity newsmakers and Hollywood culture.

name: Sotto copertura
summary: Michele Romano is the head of the Mobile Squad of Naples, a ward of men in the service of the State in a world infested with crime. After capturing the boss of the Casalesi Antonio Iovine, called "'o Ninno", Romano and his Team return to work to cut the second head of the Casalesi, that of Michele Zagaria.

name: Children's Hospital
summary: Children's Hospital follows the dramatic, fast-paced, and emotional daily lives of the doctors, nurses, and young patients navigating a busy pediatric ward.

name: Le Mystère de la Chambre Jaune
summary: Jo, a young journalist, is shocked to learn that an attempted murder has taken place in her native village of L'Artuby, nestled in the Verdon Gorge. She is devastated to discover that the victim is none other than Mathilde—a close childhood friend—who has been in a coma since the attack. The circumstances of the incident are particularly intriguing: when villagers, alerted by screams, managed to enter the victim's room, she was alone inside.

name: The Silk Road
summary: The Silk Road is a documentary television series produced by NHK that was first broadcast during the 1980s. The travelogue traced the ancient Silk Road from Chang'an (modern day Xi'an) to Rome covering the history, archaeology, culture, religion, and art of countries along the route. It took a total of 17 years from conception to complete what many considered a landmark in Japan's broadcast television history.

name: The Charlie Farrell Show
summary: The Charlie Farrell Show follows a semi-fictionalized version of a retired film star who runs the prestigious Palm Springs Racquet Club in California

name: Бесы
summary: the series follows Pyotr Verkhovensky, the leader of a revolutionary cell who attempts to recruit Nikolai Stavrogin and other young people into the revolutionary movement. To bind the cell he has created together, he plots the murder of former student Ivan Shatov, who is about to break with the revolutionaries .

name: I Am The Only God
summary: In the vast land of China, the gods who were in charge of the laws of heaven and earth died and lost their legal boundaries. The forces of darkness will move, trying to overthrow the entire land. Ning Chen was an ordinary guard in the Canglan palace. He gained the power of swallowing spirits by accident and increased his cultivation level. Initially, he was able to compensate for this. However, the crisis began . First, the royal cronies betray each other. The imperial leaders turned to each other. In the face of many hardships, Ning Chen adhered to the principle of doing things as much as his ability and responsibility, bravely raised leaders, and faced hardships together Hua Wanyue and others people , and solve crisis after crisis. However, the enemy's perilous and intertwined scheme, Ning Chen and the others gradually discovered that there was a bigger conspiracy waiting for them.

name: Pound Pups To Dog Stars
summary: Pound Pups To Dog Stars follows the rescue work of Auckland animal behaviour expert Mark Vette and his talented trainers at 'Animals on Q'. Dealing with dogs of all shapes, breeds, and sizes, Mark works with the SPCA, animal control officers and foster carers to learn the back stories of each rescue dog and how they came to be mistreated, abandoned or surrendered. Devising rehab and retraining plans for each pooch, Mark and his team embark on potentially life saving journies to try to turn the Pound Pups' lives around.

name: Gekkan! Nanmono Anime
summary: A new short anime series based on the characters "Nandemo Ikimono" created by illustrator and character designer Yuri Yokomizo. The stories follow the lives of any and all things, from animals and plants to food and objects.

name: Відважна дівчина
summary: 25-year-old Yevheniia Marchuk is one of the best operatives of the Kyiv police, who is accustomed to confidently even for difficult cases. But after the unsuccessful detention of her career is under threat of reprimand. The only chance to rectify the situation is a new task - this time to work undercover. Stolen jewels from France, Italy and Germany unexpectedly appear on the territory of the former USSR, and their trace leads to Odessa. Here the investigation is attracted by the store of antiques and art objects of Andriy Nikolayenko, the godfather of the Deputy Minister of Internal Affairs. In Odessa, the operative changes the form to the image of an art critic and gets a job in an antique shop and art objects. Among colleagues and clients, Eugenia begins to look for a person who may be a link in the international criminal network. While Marchuk is unraveling the smuggling scheme, a dangerous operation unexpectedly brings her first love.

name: Prissana
summary: Prissana takes place in 1938 in Phra Nakhon, Thailand, during a time when men and women were not equals. Marriage for women meant security, not love. Prissana is the youngest daughter of four girls and was the only one raised in America by their uncle. She is outgoing, cheerful, and pretty, but at the same time, she is also headstrong, intelligent, and opinionated. She returns to Thailand after living in Americafor 12 years and is once again reunited with her family. Prissana, whose name means "mystery, a puzzle/riddle," causes quite a stir in Thailand with her open, American behavior and refreshing beauty. She catches the attention of a lot of men, including her neighbor and Praweet, the man her third sister, Anong, is in love with. However, she takes no interest in any of them. Instead, she does develop a dislike toward Praweet's best friend, Taan Chai Puthpreecha, whom she has never met. She is prejudice towards him because everyone puts him on a pedestal because they think he's so great and perfect. Puth is amused by her uplifting spirit and intrigued by her prideful demeanor. Over the course of time, both end up having to reevaluate their presumptions of each other as they get to know one another better.

name: Две стороны одной страны
summary: Two hosts head to a new country: one enjoys a lavish, high-end vacation, while the other gets by on the bare minimum.

name: Bytet
summary: Helene and Carl trade their home in Stockholm's archipelago for a sun-drenched villa in Sicily, swapping lives for some weeks with Scarlett and Adam; a couple they've never met. But as they settle into each other's houses, unsettling details begin to surface. As secrets emerge and hidden betrayals come to light, what started as a picture‑perfect escape slowly warps into a twisted game of surveillance, manipulation and mistrust.

name: A Killer Story
summary: A Killer Story examines a polarizing murder case that spanned more than two decades and captured national attention. At the center of the case is Dana Chandler, who was accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend in 2002.

name: The Assignment with Antonia Hylton
summary:
The Assignment with Antonia Hylton will bring Hylton's thoughtful, deeply reported journalism to MS NOW's audience every weekend. 

Based in New York, The Assignment with Antonia Hylton will serve as destination viewing for the latest political and cultural headlines, informative discussions and fresh insights from top lawmakers and changemakers. Centered around Hylton's award-winning field reporting and rooted in her signature curiosity and accountability, the program will aim to help audiences better understand not only the latest headlines, but also the broader context behind them, while inviting them into a community that engages more deeply.

name: The Last Oath
summary: A zombie virus sweeps across the globe, and Lin Zai tragically discovers he carries an immunity, making him targeted by multiple factions. A-Leh, a cold-blooded assassin, is ordered to hunt him down, but when he is critically wounded, Lin Zai saves his life, and the two end up bound to each-other in a post-apocalyptic world.

name: Destino de Mujer
summary: Mariana Oropeza's life changes when she meets the young and arrogant Victor Manuel Santana, whose plans for revenge against Mariana's family lead him into unforeseen situations.

name: The Life and Crimes of William Palmer
summary: Keith Allen plays William Palmer in this true story of a Victorian-era English surgeon who uses poison to settle scores and ward off debt. William lacks a sense of regret, even after killing his wife, brother and three of his own children.

name: Komi Can't Communicate
summary: It's Komi Shouko's first day at the prestigious Itan Private High School, and she has already risen to the status of the school's Madonna. With long black hair and a tall, graceful appearance, she captures the attention of anyone who comes across her. There's just one problem though—despite her popularity, Shouko is terrible at communicating with others. Tadano Hitohito is your average high school boy. With his life motto of "read the situation and make sure to stay away from trouble," he quickly finds that sitting next to Shouko has made him the enemy of everyone in his class! One day, knocked out by accident, Hitohito later wakes up to the sound of Shouko's "meow." He lies that he heard nothing, causing Shouko to run away. But before she can escape, Hitohito surmises that Shouko is not able to talk to others easily—in fact, she has never been able to make a single friend. Hitohito resolves to help Shouko with her goal of making one hundred friends so that she can overcome her communication disorder.

name: Wild Tales
summary: Wild Tales is a children's wildlife documentary series broadcast on CBBC that follows young animals as they grow up, learn vital survival skills, and navigate the challenges of the natural world.

name: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
summary: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.

previousepisode.name: The Fall of the House of Adelson

name: Eigyou Desukara
summary:
In order to be pampered by girls, Ren has been "Selling BL" (fanservice) by flirting with Issei, a handsome guy who attends the same college. But one day, Ren is suddenly kissed by Issei?!

A fascinating love comedy that begins with a lie.

name: Başkalarının Hayatı
summary: With its story full of love, ambition, and intrigue, the series, which is set to break the mold in the new season, focuses on the dangerous test faced by a young woman who envies the lives of others.

name: Ой, мамочки
summary: The most anxiety‑relieving show about motherhood! Why it's important not to be an ideal mom, but a real one. Olya Parfenyuk, Karina Meikhanadzhyan and Maria Kravchenko will discuss the fears associated with motherhood. Together with celebrity guests — mothers themselves and those whose relatives still bombard them with questions like "so when?" — they will share their experiences, tell jokes, discuss the topic and answer the audience's questions. As usual, humour will save us, and the mums will support us!

name: Noos - L'avventura della conoscenza
summary: Noos takes the place historically occupied by Piero Angela's "Superquark". The main topic remains the same as its predecessor's, with services exploring the latest scientific discoveries in a wide array of topics: medicine, genetics, neuroscience, biology, archaeology, paleontology, and more. Moreover, it also highlights important innovations in both the energy and environment fields.

name: Superquark
summary: Superquark is a long-running Italian television program created by Piero Angela that brings science, history, nature, and technology to viewers through detailed documentaries and expert segments.

name: Head On Comedy with Jo Brand
summary: Comedy panel debate hosted by Jo Brand, in which teams captained by Bill Bailey and Ed Byrne put forward their views.

name: Phoenix Sleuth
summary: In the early years of the Republic of China, a bizarre police death case and a high-profile wealthy merchant murder case made headlines across all newspapers, with the perpetrator's identity shrouded in total mystery. No police officers could make any headway in the investigation. The victim's fiancée, Jiang Siyao, a once-famous teen detective who had retired for years, teamed up with her best friend Huo Yining, a policewoman, to track down the killers of her fiancé and father. With the help of Ye Shi'an, a wealthy young heir hiding his real identity, the three went through countless dangers along the way. Jiang Siyao not only deepened her bond with her best friend, but also developed a romantic spark with Ye Shi'an. After solving a series of connected unsolved cases one after another, the trio finally eradicated the evil forces that had lurked for years and untangled the long-held knot in Jiang Siyao's heart. As the investigation progressed, Jiang Siyao discovered that her fiancé, whom she thought was dead, was actually alive and had returned under a completely new identity.

name: The Long Race
summary: Tycoon Gao Sheng has long monopolized motorcycle racing events, reaping huge profits through rigged gambling rings and shady gray-area deals. Three years ago, he secretly tampered with Lin Ye's racing car. Chen Mo spotted the vehicle abnormality right before the race, but with no time for full troubleshooting, he insisted on swapping cars with Lin Ye to protect his partner, only to end up severely disabled and forced to retire from the racing circle. The two have since cooperated covertly, one operating in the open and the other in the shadows, biding their time and quietly collecting evidence for a total comeback. Three years later, Gao Sheng repeats his old trick, sneaking in to modify the racing car overnight to murder his target. Lin Ye, who was already well-prepared, relied on his superb driving skills to easily break the deadlock, win the championship, and gain public opinion and discourse advantage. Qin Kai, a racer who has long been coerced and controlled by Gao Sheng, witnesses Lin Ye defy the odds again and again. Struggling between his conscience and fear, Qin Kai finally defects after hearing the murder order and hands over the critical recording. Lin Ye, Chen Mo, and Lao Zhou now hold old physical evidence, combined data, physical proof, and recordings, fully confirming all of Gao Sheng's crimes.

name: The Fixers
summary: Christopher Lee and Shou Lou star as a mismatched pair of fixers for the rich and powerful, but a mysterious rival throws their mission into disarray.

name: Minerva - La scuola
summary: Minerva - La scuola is a teen drama series set in a military high school in Naples. It is a world that seems to belong to another era, where students are woken up at dawn for the flag-raising ceremony, where mobile phones and civilian clothes are not allowed, and where subjects include military tactics and fencing lessons. It is a world where love stories are forbidden and every mistake comes at a very high price.

name: Married in a Flash
summary: Country girl Lin Kexin enters an arranged flash marriage with a stranger, Gu Juncen, believing him to be an ordinary worker. Unbeknownst to her, he is actually a billionaire CEO hiding his true identity. Throughout their marriage, she faces workplace challenges and schemes, with Gu Jun always stepping in to protect her fiercely. As the truth about her real identity as a wealthy heiress comes to light, the schemes of her malicious stepmother and the impostor heiress are exposed. Lin Kexin rises as the true heiress and leader of the corporation, ultimately finding happiness with Gu Juncen.

name: Güneşin Doğduğu Yer
summary: The story revolves around the life of Kenan, the son of the Kozan family—one of Çukurova's long-established families—and how his life changes after he meets the love of his life. The story begins in Germany and continues in the world of Adana, woven with strong family ties.

name: Frust
summary: Vedran is a frustrated yet ambitious young writer, constantly struggling for attention and recognition. When he accidentally kills a drug dealer who has been terrorizing his neighborhood, he is hailed as a vigilante justice-seeker and becomes an overnight local celebrity - even though his true identity remains hidden. Realizing that it takes only one person to spark a revolution, he makes a choice that changes his life forever...

name: No More Pretense: Mr. Huo's Daily Desire for Reconciliation
summary: Bai Luo An and CEO Huo Ling end their five-year marriage, with Bai Luo An leaving a letter behind. The story follows their complicated past and the misunderstandings that shaped their relationship. As they move forward separately, both face challenges, personal growth, and the ups and downs of love, loyalty, and emotional connection.

name: The Repair Shop: Beyond the Barn
summary: The Repair Shop experts visit some of the people who have been reunited with cherished mementos.

name: Truth Under The Wheel
summary: Li Xing Chen, a former criminal investigator now working as a traffic police officer, takes on a mysterious hit-and-run case on a rainy night. Entrepreneur Gao Yu Hai is killed in the crash, but the scene has already been tampered with by someone posing as a traffic officer, erasing crucial evidence. A special task force is formed, with Li Xing Chen leading the investigation. The driver, Shen Xi, appears to have no connection to the victim, but as the investigation deepens, Li Xing Chen uncovers layer after layer of lies. Just as the case is about to be ruled a traffic accident, Xiao Ze is found hanging in a remote forest, raising new suspicions. Following the trail into the past, Li Xing Chen discovers a connection to a dance competition. On the night of a dance production, Shen Xi takes poison onstage, leaving behind a recorded message revealing the devastating abuse she suffered at the hands of the powerful. As the truth behind the rainy-night crash finally comes to light, Li Xing Chen witnesses the tragedy of ordinary people caught beneath the shadow of power—and the tangled depths of human nature hidden behind what first appeared to be an accident.

name: 9/11: Days That Shocked the World
summary: Rescue workers, survivors and witnesses relive the traumatic events of the September 11 terror attacks. Some tell their story for the first time, of how a regular morning turned into a nightmare.

name: Love Express
summary: Yun Qingqing's life falls apart in an instant. Hoping to find a decent place to quietly end it all, she is instead tricked into becoming the acting manager of a guesthouse. Before she can make sense of her new life, she finds herself chased by debt collectors and caught in the sights of Shen Feng, the owner of a local tea plantation. To her surprise, Shen Feng turns out to be the online boyfriend she ghosted years ago. Amid the chaos and unexpected encounters of everyday life, Yun Qingqing gradually heals and rediscovers the courage to love—and to let herself be loved.

name: Into the Carpathian Wild
summary:
European wildlife is threatened like never before, but in the Carpathian Mountains it has found its last great refuge. 

Home to Europe's most extensive primeval forests and the continent's largest populations of bears, wolves and lynx, the Carpathians are a stronghold of biodiversity. 

Follow the lives of this remarkable wildlife over the course of a year to reveal how each species is connected to the wider ecosystem. Together, they sustain a landscape that protects biodiversity, stores carbon and safeguards life-giving water, making the Carpathians one of Europe's most vital natural treasures.

name: Mind the Boy
summary: Jang Gi U is a 32-year-old temporary high school teacher. Four years ago, he became the subject of an inappropriate rumor involving a student. As a result, he never took the teacher certification examination and has instead spent the years moving from one contract teaching position to another. Raised in a single-mother household, he grew up constantly hearing that he had to be someone with "no flaws in the eyes of others." He lives as a person who appears flawless, but his life feels dull and unremarkable. At least, that is what everyone says.

name: The Mechanical Dragon City
summary: Two thousand years ago, the Mohist school split into two factions: Chu Mo and Qin Mo. Qin Chen, the leader of Qin Mo, instigated a great war to seize the treasure, the Heavenly Mirror. After their defeat, Chu Mo hid in the world and spent a hundred years building the Mechanical Dragon City to protect the treasure. Two thousand years later, Shen Tuo, a descendant of Chu Mo, ventures into the perilous Mechanical Dragon City with his friends to save his cursed daughter, Shen Ning, and find his missing girlfriend Jiang Mingyue. Along the way, he uncovers Qin Mo's puppets and traitors, ultimately confronting Qin Chen, the mastermind who has lived for over a thousand years. In the final battle, Shen Tuo discovers the thousand-year conspiracy behind the Heavenly Mirror and sacrifices himself to activate the ultimate Mohist mechanism, sealing the enemy within himself. Through the bond with his daughter and the secret technique of the Mystic Sky Instrument, he breaks the time loop and ushers in a dawn of rebirth.

name: Подслушано в Выборге
summary: Rybinsk is out, Vyborg is in, and instead of a visionary journalist, we have an ordinary postman. Modest 30-year-old Vitalik Tyunin lives with his mother and spends his days delivering mail across the city. Everything changes when he becomes an unwelcome witness to a crime. This absurd twist of fate sets off a chain of events that will keep Vyborg wide awake—a city where Zoya and Bayan, having arrived from Rybinsk on personal business, suddenly find themselves caught in the middle.

name: Невесомая жизнь
summary: What does a modern cartoon character look like? On the search for a universal formula for creating the perfect cartoon character.

name: Prelude of the White Snake
summary: Bai Suzhen has cultivated for five hundred years and is poised to become an immortal, yet an unfinished love tribulation robs her of an important memory. Commanded by the gods, she goes down to the mortal world to seek out Xu Xian and repay his kindness. Along with Xiaoqing, she steps into the human world and crosses paths with Xu Xian, a demon hunter haunted by his family's massacre, and Fahai, a disciple of Jinshan. Together, the four embark on a journey bound by fate.

name: Colisión
summary: When business magnate Miguel Ángel dies in a mysterious crash, his daughter Zoé and estranged wife Belén fight for control of his company.

name: Merry Berry Love
summary: A love story takes place on an Charo Island in Japan between South Korean Lee Yoo-Bin and Japanese Karin Shirahama. Lee Yoo-Bin failed big as a space planner in South Korea, while Karin Shirahama is a berry farmer, who suffers from an unknown illness.

name: Habilidad física 100: México
summary: Taqueros, cops and CrossFit champs haul massive weights, battle in hand-to-hand combat and conquer relentless physical trials for a juicy cash prize.

name: Bo! in the USA
summary: Leigh Francis reprises his role of Avid Merrion and along with Barunka O'Shaughnessy, as his wife and sister Sacha, opens a hotel in L.A. full of celebrities, including past favourites Craig David and George Michael.

name: The Prize Wall
summary: Three players take on increasingly hard rounds of trivia to compete to win amazing prizes from Brat TV Studios' The Prize Wall.

previousepisode.name: Mason Wong, Alexander Wong, and Harrison Wong

name: Love is Blind: Nederland
summary: Nicolette van Dam and Bas Smit host this social experiment where Dutch singles date and get engaged sight unseen to discover whether love truly is blind.

name: Di Hou Jin Ri En Ai Le Ma
FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
summary:
College student Kurumi Fukuga finally makes her long-awaited debut in FX (foreign exchange margin trading). Her reason? To recoup the 20 million yen her late mother lost in FX.
"I'll easily get 20 million yen back!" she vows, but
the world she plunges into is one where heaven or hell can be turned upside down in an instant. Unrealized losses, stop-loss orders, a heart that won't stop beating... Yet she still wants to buy, sell, and make money! With the addition of Yasuko and other eccentric FX warriors, the market heats up even more! A cute yet slightly (!!) dangerous money game where they fluctuate between joy and sorrow over the charts. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this turbulent world ?!

name: No.9 Hunter
summary: Since time immemorial, the Sky Rift has unleashed demonic chaos upon the mortal world. Shangguan Ziyan, a young demoness, and Yuanchu, a Taoist priest, are brought together by fate. As the two No.9 Hunters, they set out on a journey to mend the heavens. Ziyan is afflicted with the Stone Curse, which constantly reverses her yin and yang, shifting her between male and female. Yuanchu, meanwhile, is bound by a cruel fate: whom he loves shall perish. Through all their encounters with humans and demons alike, they come to realize that only their love can serve as the thread to patch the sky and save the world.

name: Abyssal Sentience
summary: In 1965, a drilling accident in the Arihundi Gobi Desert led to the mysterious disappearance of prospector Chu Hanwen. Twenty years later, the Lenghu Oilfield received a mysterious signal from the abyss, reviving a long-forgotten case. Beneath the Gobi Desert lies an unknown life form called Hundi, capable of parasitizing humans, causing mutations, and establishing an underground network sharing consciousness. Chu Nanfei, Liang Yihan, Zhou Fanghua, and others venture into the perilous Gobi abyss, confronting both infected mutants and the ambitious "Natural Science Society" while facing familial trauma and moral dilemmas. Humans attempt to suppress or control this mysterious power, while the self-aware Hundi observes and learns from humanity. When all control measures fail, humans and the aliens set aside their conflict and jointly explore their shared awakening and future.

name: Fragments of Truth
summary: Orphaned at a young age, Han Ning loses his sister in a bizarre kidnapping case. Determined to seek justice, he becomes a detective, using his natural profiling talent to catch criminals. When a strange murder takes place, it triggers a chain of subsequent homicides, and every single case is somehow tied to the unsolved disappearance of Han Ning's sister seven years ago...

name: Rutger en de buitenlanders
summary: Rutger Castricum investigates the story behind a word that is increasingly central to the social debate. At a time when 'the foreigner' is often designated as the cause of problems in the Netherlands, he speaks to twelve people who came here for various reasons. From refugees and migrant workers to people who have lived here for years and newcomers who are still looking for their place. In candid conversations, Rutger asks critical questions, searches for the man behind the label and shows that reality is often more nuanced than the debate suggests.

name: Big Day with Peter Schrager
summary: Big Day with Peter Schrager will originate from New York City and cover the biggest stories from across the sports world each day, blending reporting, interviews, unique perspectives and authentic conversations with the athletes, coaches, executives and personalities driving the day's biggest headlines. While fans can expect Schrager's trademark NFL insight and relationships, Big Day is built to celebrate the full sports landscape and the moments everyone will be talking about.

name: Sandi's Ireland: A Literary Journey
summary: Sandi Toksvig treads in the footsteps of Ireland's literary greats, to find out how an island so modest in size and population has produced one of the world's greatest literary cultures.

name: Run from Me if You Can
summary: Hui Won, an ER nurse, transfuses her own blood to save Tae Yeong, a mob boss who arrives with a gunshot wound — only to discover his deadly secret: hemophilia. On the day of her wedding, her fiancé's betrayal leaves her with nothing. Tae Yeong hands her a contract: be his fake wife for one year. With 3 billion won and her father's medical bills on the line, Hui Won is locked away in his mansion. She pushes back against his cold obsession and control, but slowly uncovers the loneliness and warmth hidden beneath his ruthless exterior — and the more she tries to escape, the deeper she falls.

name: Live From The Lycett Arms
summary: Joe Lycett presents comedy, celebrity chat and chaos from his own pub, open for only one hour a week on a Friday night, with a guest manager on hand to keep things ticking over as well as guests from the world of comedy, star-studded punters and other regulars.

name: Strawberry Shortcake's Bake Shop
summary: Strawberry's cozy neighborhood bakery is officially open, and her Berry Besties are always popping by. Sometimes they're lending a helping hand, sometimes they're hungry customers and sometimes they're just swinging by for a snack and some fun together. Whether she's whipping up desserts in her homey kitchen and bake shop, hosting friends in her snug upstairs apartment or throwing a sunshiney garden party out front, Strawberry brings the sweet warmth of a baked treat into every moment … and she's always ready for whatever friend stops by next.

name: The One About Matthew Perry
summary: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, The One About Matthew Perry reveals the real Matthew Perry - generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life - and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon.

name: The Cheetah Girls
summary: Four teens face the challenges of growing up as they sing and dance their way toward an elusive record deal as a girl group.

name: The Cut
summary: Rags-to-riches style icon Tommy Hilfiger hosts The Cut, the search for America's next top fashion designer. 16 style-savvy contestants compete for the opportunity to design their own collection under the Tommy Hilfiger label. The contestants must complete a series of tasks that showcase their design and business skills to prove they have what it takes to make the cut in the fashion world.

previousepisode.name: The Newest Designer for Tommy Hilfiger Is ...

name: Single In Marriage
summary: The world of housewife Fan Juan collapses when her husband suggests a ridiculous trade: an affair for the family's interests. Pressured by reality, she submits in humiliation, but gets only emotional cruelty and double deceit. Just when she loses all hope, two unexpected allies emerge, and together the three set out for sweet revenge. In the end, from the wreckage of her life, Fan Juan rebuilds her career and dignity, and finds a heartfelt love ten years overdue.

name: Jagamae Sangeetham
summary: A young Carnatic prodigy carries the weight of his grandfather's name and his family's survival. As financial pressure mounts and a long-buried family conflict resurfaces through his uncle Thyagaraju, Balu is pushed to question everything he's been trained to honor. An unexpected creative partnership forces him to see his tradition, and his family, in a new light.

name: The Grand Tour
summary: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show returns with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.

name: Sweet Deceit
summary: Sweet Deceit challenges teams of three competitors to search for deceptive, hyper-realistic sweets hiding in plain sight in real-world locations. Actor Josh Peck, who hilariously commands the on-screen hijinks as he leads contestants through four rounds as they try to identify masterfully disguised sweets created by world-class cake artists. Escalating in difficulty round by round, the teams work together to determine what is cake and prove it with their teeth by biting into their best guess, all in pursuit of a total prize up to $12,000.

name: La maison des bois
summary: Realistic chronicle of everyday life during the Great War. A ranger collects in his family several Parisian children refugees because of the conflict. All share the life of the country village, the school, the news from the front.

name: Basta
summary: Marco van Basten evolves from a quintessentially Dutch boy with a big soccer dream into a global phenomenon. We follow his journey from the youth fields to Ajax under the guidance of Johan Cruijff, and then on to his glory days at AC Milan. One of the absolute highlights is his wonder goal at the European Championship. But success comes at a price. How far will Van Basten go to fulfill his childhood dream?

name: Limited Time Offer
summary: Limited Time Offer is an arched competition show where 10 pop-culture food junkies compete every week to create iconic brands, with the winning product available to the public the day after the episode airs.

name: Профессиональ­ный сосед
summary: One mistake in the documents for the apartment turns the life of the Malyutin family upside down - thanks to her, the apartment raider Baev appears in their house, who gets the right to use a share in real estate and begins to survive the owners of the only housing. Strictly within the law, but far beyond the bounds of humanity.  Now Malyutin has to find out whether it is possible to defeat a professional neighbor on his own territory and which will be stronger: Baev's legal savvy or a family with nowhere else to go.

name: Nine to Five - Das Amt
summary: In the Berlin-Tiergarten-Mitte-West citizens' office, bureaucratic chaos collides with career ambitions: The new boss, Ronja, causes unrest with her attempts at optimization, while Conny keeps the place running smoothly. Amidst bureaucracy, office squabbles, and personal entanglements, everyday life at the office escalates in a wonderfully absurd way.

name: Mammoth
summary: Mammoth follows Coach Tony Mammoth, a larger-than-life high school gym teacher whose life is put on ice in 1983, when he's buried in a freak ski avalanche. Forty years later, he thaws out to a world that has completely changed... but he's convinced it really didn't need to. Still clinging to life in the '80s - complete with his Burt Reynolds moustache and treasured Trans-AM -- Mammoth returns to the job he loves, only to discover that today's rules, relationships, and realities bear little resemblance to the world he once knew.

name: Imperio de cristal
summary: Imperio de cristal centers on Sofía Vidal, whose life changes completely after attending a party at the mansion of the wealthy Lombardos—owners of a crystal factory—thereby unleashing dark secrets, family ambition, and the intrigues of Livia, the matriarch.

name: Wunderschön!
summary: Wunderschön! is a 90-minute travel program from WDR, in which different presenters explore popular holiday regions in Germany and Europe to offer viewers authentic travel tips, cultural insights, and hidden gems for the perfect vacation.

name: Die Lebensretter von Murnau
summary:
High tension in the Alpine foothills: real emergencies, tough decisions, strong stories. The Lifesavers of Murnau shows medicine where it counts – told directly, closely and intensely.

The series that follows the daily work of emergency physicians, nurses, and rescue teams at BG Unfallklinik Murnau, one of Germany's leading trauma hospitals located in the Bavarian Alps. Showing real emergency cases — from rescue operations in the mountains and severe traffic accidents to intensive care treatments, complex surgeries, and rehabilitation. With close-up footage from bodycams, drones, and cameras inside the trauma room, viewers experience how the medical teams handle life-threatening situations with precision and compassion.

name: In höchster Not - Bergretter im Einsatz
summary: In höchster Not – Bergretter im Einsatz offers a captivating, unprecedented look at the work of the mountain rescue service. Through impressive visuals and an up-close perspective, it follows real rescue missions in the Bavarian Alps. The scope ranges from challenging helicopter rescues to the tireless search for missing hikers.

name: SpyOn
summary: Spy legend Voss shocks his boss Haberland and his colleague Kocabay when he introduces them to the recruits he has chosen for their hands-on spy training: Sami, a perpetually cheerful teacher who believes her father is a top spy; Andi, a muscle-bound provincial policeman with a brilliant sense of smell; Vicky, an ambitious diplomat's daughter with catastrophic exam anxiety; Asel, a gifted mathematician with a photographic memory; and Yuki, a microsystems engineer who is virtually invisible to most people.

name: Ravenloft
summary: Described as a prestige fantasy series where adventure collides with gothic horror and tragic romance, Ravenloft and its Domains of Dread tackle adventure through character-driven stories of dark magic and supernatural intrigue. At its heart, the series follows the making of the vampire Darklord Strahd von Zarovich, whose story of power, love, obsession, and undead transformation charts his origins from tragic antihero to one of Dungeons & Dragons' most notorious villains.

name: Einfach Elli
summary: Elli Kempfer returns to her hometown of Steinau in the Karwendel Mountains to work as a paramedic and save the lives of accident victims. Her mother, Luise, raised her on her own. Leo, Luise's best friend, is like a surrogate father to Elli. She lives on her mother's farm and has ADHD. Because of this, Elli has a unique way of perceiving and experiencing the world. However, this also gives her a special strength time and again. Elli is open about it and has found her own way to structure her daily life and overcome challenges at work.

name: Cadenas de amargura
summary: After the accident in which her parents die, little Cecilia must go to live in Guanajuato with her aunts Evangelina and Natalia Vizcaíno, both single and very different from each other. Natalia loves Cecilia like a mother, but Evangelina always looks for a way to break the illusions of the girl and make her suffer, for which Cecilia has a deep fear of her.

name: Belinda
summary: After her mother's death, engineering student Belinda's life is shaken when her father reveals he has another family. Forced to live with them, she falls in love with her stepsister's boyfriend.

name: Clickbait Clinic with Stacey Dooley
summary:
Clickbait Clinic with Stacey Dooley will uncover the truth behind some of the wildest health trends taking over our social media feeds.

1 in 3 Brits now turn to social media for health advice, but how can we sort the miracle cures from the snake oil? Stacey will work with leading doctors and scientists to learn about the internet's most hyped medical claims: from fitness boosters to pain beaters, youth elixirs to fat busters, the team will trace the digital breadcrumbs to figure out how a trend went viral, meet the key influencers driving the buzz, and put the science to the test. With NHS waiting lists growing, and with social media playing an increasing role in all of our lives, The Clickbait Clinic's final verdict could be life changing... or lifesaving.
