name: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
summary:
The anime "Dragon Ball, " with original story, character designs, and concept by Akira Toriyama, is relaunched as "Dragon Ball Beerus"! This version is "enhanced," featuring a significant number of new cuts, redrawn scenes, and a restructured storyline. With the latest visual effects, this enhanced version boasts even greater realism in battle scenes and a more precise reproduction of the original manga.

Several years had passed since the fierce battle with Majin Buu, and Earth had regained a brief period of peace.

At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakened from his long slumber.

Even the Kais and Supreme Kais watched with awe as Beerus, possessing overwhelming power capable of destroying stars, awakened... But then, having heard rumors of a Saiyan who had defeated Frieza, Beerus suddenly appeared before Goku..

With Beerus, possessing unprecedented power, arriving, Earth faces the threat of annihilation... A super-intense battle that will shake the universe begins between the God of Destruction and Goku and his friends..

name: Швидкарі
summary: Швидкарі (Ambulances) is a dynamic series about emergency medical teams, their daily work, difficult decisions, team support and human stories that change both doctors and patients. The story unfolds around an unusual experiment in the capital. Frontline paramedic Max Kovalenko seeks to implement a new, more effective system of responding to calls, namely paramedics. He is convinced that the modern system of work of paramedics will help save people faster and more efficiently. To prove this, Max proposes an unusual professional competition between two emergency medical teams. His main rival is an experienced doctor Anatoly Savchuk, who has been working according to the principles of the "old school" for many years.

name: Alcanzar una estrella
summary: Lorena is in platonic love with famous singer and actor Eduardo Casablanca, who is a famous actor and singer; knows a cocktail presentation of his latest album and his first soap opera star. Some time later, Lorena goes on vacation to Ixtapa, where Eduardo is recording some stars in the soap opera. The illusion and fantasy of young love, the drive to invent an affair with Eduardo, which is followed with interest by her colleagues, who like her, are great fans of his. When Lorena is discovered, she falls into depression and loses all interest in life despite the efforts of her mother Norma and best friend Aurora. Eduardo intuits the sensitivity of a secret friend to send anonymous letters, inadvertently confessing a beautiful feeling, has a reunion with Lorena and kisses her impulsively and she doesn't understand. Lorena is discovered by Joaquin, the representative of Eduardo and begins a successful career closely watched by Deborah, who is bent on destroying his artistic life and his relationship with the singer.

name: DKDA: Sueños de juventud
summary: DKDA is a group of young artists who have been a successful group for 10 years. They are: Rodrigo, Karla, Axel, Camila, Mateo, Regina and Brenda. They have shared so much that the seven consider themselves a family, with flaws and virtues. From the beginning they have always been supported by Eduardo Arias and his wife ´´Angela. He is the producer of the band and he will always be willing to risk everything to defend it from two thieves and careerists. For her part, Laura is a young DKDA fanatic. Her biggest support is her mother Rita hers. The two have followed the trajectory of the artists from the beginning, since Laura is in love with Rodrigo. Laura's life will change when she will have her first conversation in person with the singer who for 10 years has been her idol and her love. From that moment on, differences were born between Brenda and Laura, since from being a simple fan she would become an important part of the band and gave life to Rodrigo.

name: El pecado de Oyuki
summary: Oyuki Ogino lives in a Japanese village in the early 1970s. She is a beautiful, honest, good woman whose beauty and physical attributes are used by her ambitious brother Yutaka Ogino, who exploits her and forces her to work as a Geisha.

name: El derecho de nacer
summary: When a young noblewoman becomes pregnant and her authoritarian father orders the baby destroyed to hide the disgrace, her loyal nanny rescues and raises the child in secret—never imagining that, years later, the boy, now a doctor, will save his own grandfather's life.

name: En Carne Propia
summary: Little Estefanía is celebrating her birthday and her grandfather, a millionaire, is organizing an impressive party for her. Estefanía's father, Octavio, tired of his father-in-law's humiliation, has a macabre plan that involves the disappearance of his daughter.

name: Néron: Plaidoyer pour un monstre
summary: A captivating documentary blending 3D reconstructions with expert commentary from historians. Long regarded as a bloodthirsty tyrant, the Roman Emperor Nero is now undergoing a historical re-evaluation. In this first installment, ancient historians Mischa Meier and Claudia Tiersch, alongside church historian Christoph Markschies, examine the emperor's life (37–68 AD), precisely highlighting both his often-overlooked talents and his failings. The son of Agrippina, Nero felt compelled to have her executed to put an end to their ceaseless power struggles. Furthermore, the emperor faced opposition from the elite, who mocked his artistic ambitions and failed to understand his disapproval of gladiatorial combat and wars of expansion. Nero's notorious reputation stems largely from the vindictiveness of chroniclers belonging to the ruling class—a group whose influence he had consistently curtailed.

name: Salvador de Mujeres
summary: Salvador de Mujeres tells the story of a successful boxer who loses everything and becomes an escort for wealthy women to save his family.

name: Baila conmigo
summary: Set in the late 1950s during the rise of rock and roll, the story follows Pilar, a popular young woman who falls in love with the ambitious Bruno, who is only interested in fame and adventure. As love triangles, friendships, and rivalries unfold, a group of teenagers pursues their dreams while discovering the joys and challenges of first love, music, and growing up.

name: The Great British Bake Off: Second Helpings
summary: Together with a celebrity guest in the studio, Jon and Judi will chew over the drama, celebrate the standout moments and revisit all the action from inside the Bake Off tent.

name: Why Does He Love Me So Much
По ступеням любви
summary: After her husband's betrayal, Olga files for divorce and leaves for her hometown to live with her mother and sister Masha. In Kuvshinsk, Olga meets Oleg, a policeman who is searching for a serial maniac. Feelings arise between the young people, but Olga's husband comes to the city trying to win her back.

name: Mirada de mujer
summary: After many years of marriage with her unfaithful husband. A woman in her late 40s discover that she can find love with a younger man.

name: Mirada de mujer: El regreso
summary: A married woman over the age of fifty must grapple with—and ultimately succumb to—a love that never truly ended, lingering through a long, drawn-out farewell. Amidst their comings and goings, the two lovers come to realize that being together is a difficult mission, yet one that is possible to achieve.

name: Señora Isabel
summary: The story of a fifty-year-old woman who is abandoned by her husband to go live with a woman twenty years younger than him. Alone and depressed, she stops believing in love, until one day she falls in love with a young bohemian...

name: Mia stigmi, 2 zoes
summary: Petros and Orestis are twin brothers. Orestis was put up for adoption when he was just a baby and was raised by rich parents. One day, Petros witnesses an accident which involves Orestis. Realizing they are identical and taking advantage of the fact that Orestis suffers from amnesia, Petros steals Orestis's life.

name: Dos mujeres, un camino
summary: Johnny is a Mexican truck driver and family man, deeply in love with his wife, Ana María. On a work trip, Johnny almost runs over a beautiful woman named Tania and falls in love with her.

name: Muchachitas
summary: The story of four young women from different social classes who navigate the challenges of adolescence while trying to break into the arts. The girls will face off against Federico Cantú, who is trying to claim the inheritance of one of their fathers.

name: Pobre niña rica
summary: Consuelo lives a life with very little love, and she doesn't believe that she will ever find the love of a man. But on a trip to Paris, Consuelo meets Julio Navarro, a brilliant doctor who immediately discovers in her a beautiful, intelligent and strong woman who only needs a little love. Together with Julio, Consuelo will face her family, but Teresa and Carlos will not give up so easily and will continue trying to dominate and destroy her and thus be able to take control of her family inheritance.

name: Nunca Digas Adeus
summary: Vera de Almeida Barreto highlights her choices as a woman dedicated to family, sacrificing herself to support her husband's career and raise their three children. Upon discovering Lourenço's affair with lawyer Daniela Lopes, a younger woman, Vera reevaluates her life, questioning her role as a woman and facing a lack of support from her children in this challenging situation. The plot becomes even more complex when Vera falls in love with a younger man, challenging societal norms and exposing the double standards surrounding age differences in relationships.

name: Amores de Mercado
summary: Two twin brothers are separated at birth, one living a millionaire life and the other a simple life, after an accident both exchange their lives.

name: Romané
summary: A caravan of gypsies arrives in Mejillones, Chile, to celebrate the marriage of their king, without imagining that the repentant arrival of his daughter after two decades, will revive a stormy past.

name: Amores querer con alevosía
summary: This is a love story in which there are different ways of feeling it. Carolina belongs to a middle-class family. She lives with her parents and her two sisters and she has a boyfriend named Mario. In college, he accidentally meets Pablo, a young man who appears in an affair with his girlfriend

name: Muchachitas como tú
summary: Muchachitas como tú follows the story of Isabel, Elena, Mónica, and Leticia—four young women from vastly different backgrounds and social classes who meet at an arts academy to study acting, dance, and singing, sharing the dream of achieving success and overcoming life's adversities to find happiness.

name: Route 187
summary: Citizens combat urban violence until a bus driver and student's murders by thugs spark outrage, leading authorities to hunt the culprits captured on video.

name: Middlehood
summary: For Lisa Giordano Navarro, midlife is messy. At 50, she crashes head-on into a moment when the years she's lived meet the years she has left - and it scares her. So she blows up her life for a chance at a do-over.

name: El Resto Bien
summary: A 50-year-old cartoonist with five kids and aging parents faces a mid-life crisis, complicated by a hernia. His physical limits force him to reflect on freedom, family duties, and what matters most.
